scope: Frozen full-34 development ablations of causal event ordering and duplicate-family budgeting; not independent contact or line-judgment accuracy.

reference_policy.primary: 32 previously exposed videos: old24 contains 13 scorable references; exposed8 contains 4. Primary denominator is 17, with 15 excluded for visibility/ambiguity.
reference_policy.controls: Two original control videos are reported separately (2/2 scorable), not added to the primary score.
reference_policy.pooled: 34/19 is an explicitly pooled regression summary, not the primary result.
reference_policy.labels: Frozen AI visual approximate first-landing-vicinity object centers, not independently human-verified cork contact points or IN/OUT labels.
reference_policy.match: Both the frozen frame interval (plus its predeclared frame tolerance) and scaled pixel-distance tolerance must pass; no post-prediction tolerance changes.

execution_notes: Baseline executes the full source-video pipeline. v4 variants replay events/identity/native-contact/decision using baseline tracks and calibration plus hash-verified actual source analysis pixels.
The optional read-only frame cache is bound to original source, timestamps, preprocessing, dimensions and the baseline decoded-frame SHA. Replay timing is not full-pipeline timing.
Frozen v4 receipts do not describe later family-member ordering fixes, native-recovery experiments or the final release source.

conclusion.causal_ordering: Primary first-vicinity matches increase 7/17 to 8/17; controls remain 2/2. Only ordinary-1-a changes, from a later observed rebound to the earlier inferred first-vicinity candidate. Existing successes and recall@6/@12 are preserved.
conclusion.family_diversity_reason: No top-1 or recall@6/@12 gain in the complete 34-video ablation; keep this optional mechanism disabled by default.
conclusion.accuracy_claim: Improved approximate candidate localization/order only; no measured physical-contact or legal line-call accuracy.

case_encoding: Every variant has exact report scores and result SHA. Missing selected/selected_comparison fields inherit baseline_selection/baseline_comparison in that case; selection_changed compares track, frame, time, point and method, excluding display event_id.

source_evidence_figure.timestamp_semantics: Saved normalized source timestamps; original PTS origin is recorded separately.

decoder.frame_selection: sequential decode from frame zero, no seeking or frame interpolation

overview_panels.marker_semantics: saved candidate location, not an uncertainty radius or fabricated observation
saved candidate location, not an uncertainty radius or fabricated observation

source_evidence_figure.crop_selection_policy: Display-only neighborhoods chosen after frozen experiments; these rectangles are never inference inputs.
source_evidence_figure.resampling: Pillow LANCZOS for display-only resizing; all crops are actual source pixels without prediction overlays
source_evidence_figure.scope: Actual source frames and unchanged saved candidate markers. The f158 coordinate is inferred, not a measured source observation. No physical contact or target identity is certified.
